industry.why: Neutral, carried, with the evidence moved towards the tape. Component 1 regime, 30-Oct-26 (risk-off beneath a steady index, led now by credit and the cost of debt rather than by the artificial intelligence wash-out alone: the US ten-year above 5% after a hawkish Fed hold with two dissents for a hike, Goldman Sachs' Risk Appetite Indicator at its lowest since April 2025, euro investment-grade and high-yield yields up 30 and 90 basis points since September, Brent near $115, the French premium a record 150 basis points, Europe rotating to quality, defensives and non-AI growth, the STOXX Europe 600 1.7% from its high with breadth recovering from the bottom fifth of three years and defensives leading cyclicals at four weeks and three months; sources present 2026-W44): third-quarter beats were sold (Sandvik down 5%, Atlas Copco down 8%, Hiab down 12%), Danske Bank's C-J (25 October) says 'a lot is priced in' with the order strength coming from data centres the market no longer pays for, and the exception is the non-AI compounder (Hexagon, 13% organic growth); against it, offshore services and nuclear have multi-year visibility and electrical equipment is still the physical bottleneck. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-30 against 2026-08-28, not week on week: D now, C prior. The sector rows do the work: Electrical equipment, Diversified groups, Distributors, Test and measurement and Engineered components at C, Flow control and Building technology at D. Five live holdings (19.35 points of the book) sit here, judged in component 4. Counter-case for D: a tape that sells beats is a regime statement; for B: the order data remain the strongest non-AI demand read in the pack. To D on a second week of beats sold with relative strength falling to F.

sector.why: Neutral, set deliberately this week (carried C). Component 1 regime, 16-Oct-26 (a discount-rate shock with the first credit crack inside the artificial intelligence chain: United States core inflation re-accelerating on energy, the Fed and Bank of England hikes pulled forward, the US 10-year about 5.1%, the US joined the sell-off and Asia is in washout, defensives bid for four weeks in Europe, European breadth off its three-year lows but in the bottom quarter, the consumer forecast to weaken into winter; sources present 2026-W42): diversified industrial groups are cyclical capital goods into a growth scare, but their diversification is itself the simple, proven profile the regime pays for, and Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-16 against 2026-08-14, not week on week: A now, C prior, says the market is paying for it. Three memos this week in this Sector all turn on the Fragility axis, not on the Sector: Beijer Alma (Mixed) and Idun Industrier (Fights it) are small, geared, re-rating-dependent Swedish acquirers, thyssenkrupp (Mixed) is large but 'neither simple nor proven'; the Fragility row carries that judgement, so the Sector row does not double it. One live holding, Sdiptech (5.05%, Sell-side and Thematic Fit A). Counter-case for higher: leadership and six MI Pool names with Thematic Fit B; for lower: the group's small acquirers are what a credit crack hurts first. Neutral by judgement.

geography.why: Neutral, carried. No Swedish survey and no Riksbank reading reached the pack this week, so the condition for B (a confidence print at or above normal with the Riksbank on hold) could not be tested; the only Swedish data point is food retail volumes up 5.3% in September after a value-added tax cut (Danske, 18 Oct), which is a sector fact, not a country view. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43). Four live holdings are Swedish (Avanza 0.50%, Hexatronic 4.95%, Sdiptech 5.05%, Xvivo 5.05%, 15.55 points), judged in component 4 and in amendment 10. Relative strength is not graded by country.

items.criterion: Industry RS below 30, read each Friday

bullets.text: No sell signal: Sdiptech's Industry RS (Industrials and capital goods) read 46 on Fri 30-Oct, against the line of 30.
Sdiptech's Industry RS fell from 79 on 9-Oct to 46 on 23-Oct, a rotation into defensives, and read 46 again on 30-Oct.
A reading of 26 or lower on Fri 6-Nov, three places lower, sells the whole Sdiptech holding at the Tue 10-Nov session.

items.criterion: Sector RS below 50 with Stock RS below 70, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal: Sdiptech's Sector RS (Diversified industrial groups) is 72 and its Stock RS 84 at the 30-Oct month-end.
Sdiptech's Sector RS fell 20 points from 92 on 16-Oct as large sector members fell; its Stock RS rose from 80 at 30-Sep.
A sell signal at the 30-Nov month-end needs Sdiptech's Sector RS down 23 more points and its Stock RS down 15.

items.criterion: Relative price more than 25% below its 52W high, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal: Sdiptech's relative price is 6.6% below its 52W high (14-Oct) at the 30-Oct month-end.
Sdiptech's relative price was 1.1% below its high on 2-Oct and 2.3% below on 23-Oct.
At a flat market, only a Sdiptech close below about 205.6, 19.7% lower, gives a sell signal at the 30-Nov month-end.

items.criterion: A tranche 30% below its highest close since purchase, with Stock RS below 70

bullets.text: No sell signal: Sdiptech tranches 1 to 3's 30% level is 189.42, 26.0% below the close; tranche 4's is 179.2.
Sdiptech's Stock RS is 84, so a 30% fall would also need Stock RS below 70 to trigger a tranche.
A triggered Sdiptech tranche sells at the Tuesday session after its release (a 15% rebound from its low, or 63 trading days).

items.criterion: SS Sales or SS PT Net Upgrade Breadth below zero AND Stock RS below 50, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal: Sdiptech's Stock RS is 84; on the data file's own series its revenue and PT Net Upgrade Breadth are +71% and +43%.

The Framework 14 reading of the 30-Oct month-end, rebuilt on 2-Nov under your 2-Nov rules, computed this test from the 100-day analyst counts (revenue 5 of 7 analysts raising, PT 3 of 7, none cutting): no sell signal.
Sdiptech's PT Net Upgrade Breadth has thinned from +100% at the June month-end to +43%, with no analyst cutting.

items.criterion: The 200D MA of relative price flat or falling over the month, read each Friday

bullets.text: No sell signal: Sdiptech's relative 200D MA rose 2.53% over the month to Fri 30-Oct.
The rise has quickened from 1.66% over the month to 2-Oct.
Low: Sdiptech's relative 200D MA cannot turn flat for weeks, even in a sharp fall.

adds.criterion: The rules: no sell signal from the six Sell Criteria

bullets.text: No sell signal from any of Sdiptech's six Sell Criteria at the 30-Oct readings, so the rules allow an add.
Industry RS of 26 or lower on Fri 6-Nov would give a sell signal, block an add and sell the holding.

adds.criterion: The rules: room below the holding's limit

bullets.text: Sdiptech is 6.05% of capital after tranche 4 (1.00%, 30-Oct), leaving 0.63% of room below the 6.68% limit.
The room is less than a full 1.67% Core Investment tranche, so any further add is a part tranche.

adds.criterion: Where Sdiptech stands for an add: pulling back or basing; may be retesting or forming a VCP; healthily retesting or breaking out

bullets.text: Pulling back or basing, the first stage: the Master Dashboard reads pulling back 4 of 4 tests, basing 3 of 4, healthy retest 2 of 6.
Sdiptech is at the edge of the second stage: four closes since 8-Oct held the rising 50D MA, the latest 0.89% above it.
A Sdiptech close above 264.0, then 270.6, on 1.5 times average volume would make it a healthy retest of a rising MA.

adds.criterion: Your add trigger: a positive retest of a rising MA

bullets.text: Partly present: Sdiptech pulled back to its rising 50D MA (up 2.4% in 20 sessions) and has not closed below it since 25-Sep.
Volume dried to 0.23 times average on 30-Oct, as a healthy retest should, but no bounce has yet held above 264.0.
A Sdiptech close below 252.4 and the 50D MA on 1.5 times average volume would fail the retest.

adds.criterion: Your add trigger: a broadening of the case (momentum rising in guidance, sell-side estimates, technicals or peers)

bullets.text: Partly present: Sdiptech's sell-side estimates rose (FY2027 revenue up 4.0% in October), but EPS and PT breadth thinned and a first non-Buy appeared.
Guidance caps the margin (2026 margins "representative"); Sdiptech's technicals are basing, not rising; peers Indus Holding and Lifco are falling.
Rising PT and FY2027 EPS breadth at the November month-end, and Indus Holding's 12-Nov report holding the cohort.
On 28-Oct you wrote in your Notion note: "Would be happy to add 1% if retest opportunity emerges"; tranche 4 (1.00%) was bought on 30-Oct.
That note's add is done; it named no further add, and the 0.63% of room left is less than a full tranche.
